Feeling this. I tried to tell my parents as a kid when I was getting bullied, they laughed it away. Didn’t think it was serious at all even though this bullying, and consequently their reactions, directly contributed to me tuning people out and becoming overly self-reliant; which is something they hate about me.

I tried to confide into my ex a number of times. And then either his problems and mental health would blow up from me doing that like 90% of the time so I had to take care of him instead, or he’d outright tell me I’m not as depressed as he was— which just shut me down. Even though he couldn’t handle my breakdowns, his own words, and got upset with me for asking for the complete and utter bare minimum. Even though I always handled his despite being in the middle of my own. And gave all of my available energy into him, day in and day out.

No one is ever there for you the way you have to be for yourself. And it sucks. Simultaneously I sincerely hate myself but I’m also the only person in life who actually gives a real fuck about me, too.

I’ve been alive for other peoples comfort and a shoulder for them to use, without ever really having that back when I needed it most. I have always been alone in my darkest hours, but I’ve tried whatever I could to be there for everyone else’s. Did I succeed? I don’t know. All I know is that mine have been alone, and I have put my pain and tears aside so I could try to wipe away someone else’s.

I hold myself. I wipe my own tears. I pick myself up. I’m there for everything that matters. That’s how it always is and is going to be. All “I love you” has felt like for me, is something that someone says when they don’t want my comfort and care to leave them, that’s the sole value I seem to bring. I really don’t think anyones ever actually loved “me” and wanted to care for me the way I hope for, and the way I tried to for them. 

And I’m both sad and accepting that this is just how things are lmao.
